title: NPCore: First Steps
summary: Make first contact with an ECHO NPC and identify the useful screen state.

blocks.title: Approach And Read
blocks.body: Right-click the NPC, pause on the first dialogue node, and read the active options before choosing a trade, service, or exit action.

blocks.title: Confirm The Contact
blocks.body: Check the name, role, faction, portrait, and status line. If those are generic, the NPC may be using fallback profile data.

blocks.title: First Clean Win
blocks.body: Complete one harmless dialogue option or low-cost trade, then close the screen. That proves the profile, dialogue, network sync, and interaction range all work.

blocks.title: Ready Check
blocks.body: Before moving on, confirm the first setup step is repeatable and safe enough to do again.
